newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE nearby white sugar ends at lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE nearby white sugar ends at lows.

text.p: Nearby LIFFE white sugar futures deepened losses by Monday's close, finishing at the day's lows.
Most active March finished $3.20 easier at $297.50 per tonne, the day's low, after touching a high of $300.00.
May also ended at $297.50, the day's nadir, $2.70 weaker.
Volume was 3,327 lots, with the bulk of it, 2,018 lots, in March.
Traders said a weak New York raws market weighed down prices, which had already been under pressure.
In Paris, March ended down $2.10 at $298.00 and May finished 20 cents lower at $298.10.
